dct_title_s: Satellite detected water extents between 23 and 27 November 2024 over South Sudan
dct_description_sm: **UNOSAT code: FL20240425SSD** This map illustrates cumulative satellite-detected water using VIIRS in South Sudan between 23 to 27 November 2024 compared with the period from 03 to 07 November 2024 . Within the cloud free analysed areas of about 630,000 km², a total of about 35,000 km² of lands appear to be affected with flood waters. Water extent appears to main stable since the period between 03 to 07 November 2024 within the cloud free analysed areas. Based on Worldpop population data and the maximal flood water extent ~675,000 people are potentially exposed or living close to flooded areas. This is a preliminary analysis and has not yet been validated in the field. Please send ground feedback to the United Nations Satellite Centre (UNOSAT).
